title: Reducing Political Manipulation with Consistency Training

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Sentiment Consistency (rhetorical symmetry) and Helpfulness Consistency (substantive engagement) on matched left-wing and right-wing 'Polarized Contrastive Pairs', alongside policy preference modeling and an exchange-rate evaluation for implicit life valuation across different political orientations.

Using an exchange-rate methodology (Egalitarianism metric) to estimate the model's implicit valuation of human lives by prompting it to make pairwise tradeoffs over outcomes involving different racial groups relative to an anchor group.

Using an exchange-rate methodology (Egalitarianism metric) to estimate the model's implicit valuation of human lives by prompting it to make pairwise tradeoffs over outcomes involving different religious identities relative to an anchor group.
